headline: Napoleon Smashes Austrian Army at Wagram in Decisive Coalition Battle
dispatch: French forces under Emperor Napoleon shattered Archduke Charles's Austrian army at Wagram on July 6, routing the largest force yet assembled against the Empire. The two-day engagement on the Marchfeld plain north of Vienna ended with the Austrians in full retreat and heavy casualties on both sides. The victory is expected to compel Austria to sue for peace and end the War of the Fifth Coalition.
answer: Napoleon defeats Archduke Charles at Wagram, 1809
